title: Nuclear Fallout Protection
description: Interactive guide to the first minutes after a nuclear explosion: get into a sturdy building, move to the basement or center, take off outer clothing and wash, and stay inside at least 24 hours. Covers FEMA protection factors, the 7-10 decay rule, potassium iodide, food and water, pets, and signs of radiation sickness.
shortDescription: Get inside, basement or center, 24+ hours, cleanup, KI rules, and the 7-10 rule
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
